√has 'laugh'
present: [1.] hásati etc. B.+ hásate etc. E.+ 
perfect: jahāsa jahasus E.+ jahase 
aorist: [1.] ahāsi -- [3.] ajīhasat -- [5.] ahasīt 
future: [1.] hasiṣyati E.+ -- [2.] hasitā 
verbal: hasita E.+ hasitum hasitvā E.+ -hasya E.+ 
secondary: passive: hasyate etc. -- intensive: jāhasyate -- desiderative: jihasiṣa- -- causative: hāsayati etc. 
derivatives: has- hása V.+ hasá AV. -hásya AV. hāsa B.+ hāsaka E. hāsin AV.+ hāsya E.+ hasanā́ RV. ḥasana E.+ hasanīya C. hāsana C. hasrá RV. -hásvan RV. 
Compare the derivative root 2jakṣ.

√hās 'go emulously'
present: [1.] hā́sate etc. 
secondary: causative: hāsayanti 
A secondary form of √1, 2hā (hā́sante AV. iv. 36. 5 is omitted in the Atharva-Veda Index).
